b15_0001.en: A document containing descriptions and schematics of Miho technology.
b15_0001.old: A document containing descriptions and schematics of Miho technology.

b15_0002.en: A giant mulberry tree inhabited by ebony silkworms. Mulberries grow all year round.
b15_0002.old: A giant mulberry tree inhabited by ebony silkworms. Mulberries grow all year round.

b15_0003.en: A guided missile used by the Medium-MAT for any situation. It has a collateral shrapnel effect.
b15_0003.old: A guided missile used by the Medium-MAT for any situation. It has a collateral shrapnel effect.

b15_0004.en: A guided plasma missile used by the Medium-MAT for fending off mechanoids. The heavy plasma warhead packs a devastating anti-mech firepower.
b15_0004.old: A guided plasma missile used by the Medium-MAT for fending off mechanoids. The heavy plasma warhead packs a devastating anti-mech firepower.

b15_0005.en: A heavily armed pioneer tank with an improved engine. It is equipped with a powerful Wasteland Reclamation Missile.
b15_0005.old: A heavily armed pioneer tank with an improved engine. It is equipped with a powerful Wasteland Reclamation Missile.

b15_0006.en: A heavy multi-purpose tank equiped with a large plasma gun suitible for sieging.
b15_0006.old: A heavy multi-purpose tank equiped with a large plasma gun suitible for sieging.

b15_0007.en: A heavy multi-purpose tank equiped with an anti-infantry grenade launcher. Not suited to take out heavily armored targets.
b15_0007.old: A heavy multi-purpose tank equiped with an anti-infantry grenade launcher. Not suited to take out heavily armored targets.

b15_0008.en: A heavy multi-purpose tank suitable for combat. Depending on the situation it can switch between an armor piercing anti-tank gun or an anti-infantry gun.
b15_0008.old: A heavy multi-purpose tank suitable for combat. Depending on the situation it can switch between an armor piercing anti-tank gun or an anti-infantry gun.

b15_0009.en: A highly concentrated helianto flower juice. Drinking it quickly calms neural heat.
b15_0009.old: 含有高浓度机械体成分的汤药。饮用后能迅速平复神经热。

b15_0011.en: A large mech factory capable of producing a variety of mechanoids.
b15_0011.old: A large mech factory capable of producing a variety of mechanoids.

b15_0012.en: A magical lamp that provides warmth and enough light for crops to grow.
b15_0012.old: A magical lamp that provides warmth and enough light for crops to grow.

b15_0013.en: A massive engine used in the largest Miho mechanoids.
b15_0013.old: A massive engine used in the largest Miho mechanoids.

b15_0014.en: A mechanite creature that helps hauling.
b15_0014.old: A mechanite creature that helps hauling.

b15_0015.en: A mechanite creature with sharp wings.
b15_0015.old: A mechanite creature with sharp wings.

b15_0016.en: A multi-purpose tank suitable for reconnaissance, fortification and elimination.
b15_0016.old: A multi-purpose tank suitable for reconnaissance, fortification and elimination.

b15_0017.en: A pill for children that blooms psychic powers. Has no effect on Miho already owning psychic powers. "It's very bitter, so give me chocolate later."
b15_0017.old: 能让超能力觉醒的银丹。已经拥有超能力的美狐服用后没有效果。"很苦，待会儿要给我巧克力哦。"

b15_0020.en: A portal spawning a Helper Fox.
b15_0020.old: A portal spawning a Helper Fox.

b15_0021.en: A portal spawning an Arcane Thrumbo.
b15_0021.old: A portal spawning an Arcane Thrumbo.

b15_0022.en: A powder of tiny mechanite crystals extracted from meat. Easy to store.
b15_0022.old: 从肉类中提取的微小机械体晶体粉末，易于储存。

b15_0023.en: A rare substance that has a negative mass and is rarely found on the rimworld.
b15_0023.old: A rare substance that has a negative mass and is rarely found on the rimworld.

b15_0024.en: A raw material for ceramic that is well kneaded with various elements.
b15_0024.old: A raw material for ceramic that is well kneaded with various elements.

b15_0025.en: A reinforced material that combines steel and ceramic.
b15_0025.old: 将钢铁与陶瓷融合而成的强化材料，用于军用护甲与武器。

b15_0027.en: A small ornithopter suitable for agriculture.
b15_0027.old: A small ornithopter suitable for agriculture.

b15_0028.en: A specialized long range siege tank tank equipped with a cluster rocket battery.
b15_0028.old: A specialized long range siege tank tank equipped with a cluster rocket battery.

b15_0029.en: A specialized medium range siege tank equipped with a multi rocket battery.
b15_0029.old: A specialized medium range siege tank equipped with a multi rocket battery.

b15_0030.en: A superior multi-purpose combat tank protected by a projectile interceptor shield. It's autocannon is capable of annihilating light and heavily armored enemies with ease. Additionally it is equipped with a long range anti-tank missile.
b15_0030.old: A superior multi-purpose combat tank protected by a projectile interceptor shield. It's autocannon is capable of annihilating light and heavily armored enemies with ease. Additionally it is equipped with a long range anti-tank missile.

b15_0031.en: A sushi bento that foxes love. Made with substitute yubu. (Helianto, Corn/Potatoes, Rice)
b15_0031.old: A sushi bento that foxes love. Made with substitute yubu. (Helianto, Corn/Potatoes, Rice)

b15_0032.en: A unarmed light tank specialized in supporting psycasters by absorbing their neural heat. It is also equipped with an emergency healing ray.
b15_0032.old: A unarmed light tank specialized in supporting psycasters by absorbing their neural heat. It is also equipped with an emergency healing ray.

b15_0033.en: A work assistant AI and holographic projector with four built-in personalities. It can be connected to the Shaft Furnace, Celestial Furnace, and General Workbench.
b15_0033.old: A work assistant AI and holographic projector with four built-in personalities. It can be connected to the Shaft Furnace, Celestial Furnace, and General Workbench.

b15_0035.en: Ebonsilk is a beautiful, heat-insulating silk made by burning the cocoons of silkworms that ate medicinal herbs. Can be harvested from mullberry trees.
b15_0035.old: Ebonsilk is a beautiful, heat-insulating silk made by burning the cocoons of silkworms that ate medicinal herbs. Can be harvested from mullberry trees.

b15_0037.en: Genetically engineered plants. It mainly serves as a signal to collect substances that enhance Miho's mind.
b15_0037.old: 基因工程改造的植物。主要作为信号收集增强美狐精神的物质。

b15_0038.en: It is a comprehensive workbench that imitates human 3D printers.
b15_0038.old: It is a comprehensive workbench that imitates human 3D printers.

b15_0039.en: It is a high-performance generator that was stolen from somewhere. It is quite unstable, so it returns to its original position after a certain period of time.
b15_0039.old: It is a high-performance generator that was stolen from somewhere. It is quite unstable, so it returns to its original position after a certain period of time.

b15_0040.en: Kampe the recycling bot can turn collected trash into valuable resources.
b15_0040.old: Kampe the recycling bot can turn collected trash into valuable resources.

b15_0041.old: 用普通陶瓷与金属精炼而成的高级陶瓷。坚固而用途广泛，用于制作高级装备。

b15_0043.en: Tea made from the helianto flower petals. It is fragrant and warm, so drinking it can make you a little tired.
b15_0043.old: 用太阳花的花瓣冲泡的茶。香气宜人、温暖舒适，饮用后可能会有些困倦。

b15_0044.en: The fruit of the ebony mulberry tree. It is used as an ingredient in medicine. When eaten raw it has an excellent taste. However, the storage period is short.
b15_0044.old: The fruit of the ebony mulberry tree. It is used as an ingredient in medicine. When eaten raw it has an excellent taste. However, the storage period is short.

b15_0045.en: The petals are agglomerated substances that help Miho's minds to be expressed.
b15_0045.old: 凝聚了帮助美狐精神表达的物质的花瓣。

b15_0047.en: Tobacco made by drying helianto flowers. When smoking, it quickly replenishes yang and makes you feel better.
b15_0047.old: 由晒干的太阳花制成的烟。吸食后能迅速补充阳气，让人心情愉悦。

b15_0048.en:
경장갑을 갖추고, 로켓 포드가 탑재된 순항 오니솝터 입니다. 기존의 화학연료 대신 아침동안 모인 태양열 에너지로 메카나이트 코어를 가동시켜 금속제 인공근육으로 날갯짓을 합니다. 메카나이트 코어는 친환경적이란 장점이 있지만. 보통 과열되기 쉽고, 식히기는 어려워 순항거리가 짧고, 엔진 과열로 인한 비행 대기 시간이 보통 셔틀에 비해 깁니다.
		
주의사항 : 연료량이 15이상이면 로켓 포드가 자동 발사 됩니다!
b15_0048.old:
装备轻装甲、搭载火箭挂架的巡航扑翼机。不同于使用化学燃料的普通穿梭机，它利用清晨收集的太阳能驱动机械核心，通过金属人造肌肉扇动机翼。机械核心虽然环保，但容易过热且难以冷却，导致巡航距离较短，因发动机过热所需的飞行等待时间通常也比普通穿梭机更长。

注意：燃料量达到15以上时，火箭挂架会自动发射！

b15_0049.en: 굉장히 귀한 취급을 받는 커다란 분재 입니다. 주기적으로 비단을 생산 합니다.

b15_0050.en: 농업에 적합한 팔과 커터가 달렸었던 스펙스급 오니솝터 입니다. 폭탄을 달기 위해 굉장히 경량화 되었습니다.

b15_0051.en: 다연장 로켓 메카노이드의 장전과 방열, 포격을 관장하는 컴퓨터칩 입니다.

b15_0052.en: 미호 대형 메카나이트가 든 보급상자 입니다.

b15_0056.en: 미호 태양화 가루(x500)가 든 보급상자 입니다.

b15_0057.en: 미호 태양화 담배(x25)가 든 보급상자 입니다.

b15_0058.en: 미호의 초능력을 발현할수있게 도와주는 물질이 응집된 이끼입니다. 이 식물은 점도가 높고, 굉장히 역한 맛을 지니고 있어 스토브에서 가루로 가공하여 사용해야 합니다.
b15_0058.old: 凝聚了帮助美狐超能力表达的物质的海绵。这种植物黏度很高、味道极差，需要放在炉灶上加工成粉末后使用。

b15_0059.en: 셔틀의 대체품인 순항 오니솝터 입니다. 기존의 화학연료 대신 아침동안 모인 태양열 에너지로 메카나이트 코어를 가동시켜 금속제 인공근육으로 날갯짓을 합니다. 메카나이트 코어는 친환경적이란 장점이 있지만. 보통 과열되기 쉽고, 식히기는 어려워 순항거리가 짧고, 엔진 과열로 인한 비행 대기 시간이 보통 셔틀에 비해 깁니다. 아웃도어용 작은 화학연료 발전기 또한 장착되어 있습니다.
b15_0059.old: 作为穿梭机替代品的巡航扑翼机。它利用清晨收集的太阳能驱动机械核心，通过金属人造肌肉扇动机翼，而非使用化学燃料。机械核心虽然环保，但容易过热且难以冷却，导致巡航距离较短，因发动机过热所需的飞行等待时间通常也比普通穿梭机更长。此外还配备了小型户外化学燃料发电机。

b15_0060.en: 유전자 조작된 식물입니다. 주로 미호들의 초능력을 증진시켜주는 물질을 모으는 신호기 역할을 합니다.
b15_0060.old: 基因工程改造的植物。主要作为信号收集增强美狐精神的物质。

b15_0061.en: 유전자 조작된 식물입니다. 주로 미호들의 초능력을 증진시켜주는 물질을 모으는 신호기 역할을 합니다. 이 식물은 점도가 높고, 굉장히 역한 맛을 지니고 있어 스토브에서 가루로 가공하여 사용해야 합니다.
b15_0061.old: 基因工程改造的植物。主要作为信号收集增强美狐精神的物质。这种植物黏度很高、味道极差，需要放在炉灶上加工成粉末后使用。

b15_0064.en: 혐오스럽게 변이된 비밀병기 입니다. 이 녀석을 자세히 보았다간...
